drivers.notes: ESC/VP21 is shared across Epson's business and installation projector lines. Per-model variation is in which input codes the projector actually accepts (e.g. older units have no HDBaseT input). The driver lets the user pick from the union of all common codes; unsupported codes return ERR on the projector, which the driver logs at debug.
